items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Roosevelt was head of that out in California, and they used me to open these things

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah -- was that Roosevelt's son?

Yeah, Roosevelt was head of that out in California, and they used me to open these things -- I don't know if anyone remembers, but if they remember, when you put the dime in, you saw this guy, you saw a closeup of this guy beating on the drums and smiling, and they faded back and faded back until there wasn't any more of him, and that was me -- and then the name of the song and the orchestra came on.
